evidence.section_2: Intent descriptions and three examples were provided to collectors; exact descriptions are not printed here.
evidence.scope: Original source paper read; no original task checkpoint, split identity, or intent-card definitions recovered.

provenance.definitions: Project-authored provisional descriptions based on native names, not quoted original collection instructions; no target transcript examples or model scores used.

candidates.description: Banking or card use while abroad.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Whether the original class covers all banking abroad or only card use is not established.

candidates.description: Changing or checking the address recorded for the customer by the bank.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Whether bank branch or recipient addresses are excluded needs original description evidence.

candidates.description: Reporting or seeking help with an error in the banking application.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Application failure during a payment may overlap a payment request; native priority rule is unknown.

candidates.description: Asking about or changing the limit on cash withdrawals from an ATM.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Requested withdrawal amount and limit-change coverage need original rule confirmation.

candidates.description: Checking the available balance or amount of money in an account.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: A request mentioning a transaction to explain a balance may overlap transaction history.

candidates.description: Asking about or applying for a loan for a business.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Eligibility, application and repayment coverage have not been certified.

candidates.description: Reporting or seeking help with a problem with a bank card.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Lost, stolen, blocked and malfunctioning cards may overlap freeze; original priority rule is unknown.

candidates.description: Asking about or making a deposit of physical cash into an account.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Deposits at an ATM concern depositing, not withdrawal limits; exact native scope remains unverified.

candidates.description: Asking about, arranging or managing a direct debit payment authorization.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Recurring payments are not automatically direct debits; cancellation and dispute scope needs evidence.

candidates.description: Requesting or asking about freezing or blocking a banking facility.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: The object could be an account or card; the original description is needed before choosing narrower wording.

candidates.description: Asking about or arranging a payment of a large monetary amount.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: No numerical large-amount cutoff is supplied by the paper; do not invent one.

candidates.description: Asking about, opening or managing a bank account shared by multiple holders.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Information, opening and changes to holders may or may not all belong to the original task.

candidates.description: Requesting or checking recent account transactions or transaction history.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: A dispute about an individual transaction may exceed a history request; original scope is unknown.

candidates.description: Asking about or making a payment to settle a bill.
candidates.unresolved_boundary: Bill payments may also be large or use direct debit; native precedence is not established.

supervision: Original target event index retained. Other candidate negatives mean exclusive class membership only, not complete semantic intent absence.
remaining: Recover or document absence of original collection instructions; resolve overlapping class scope before finalizing cards.
Freeze project evaluation population and exposure rules.
Materialize opaque audio identifiers and resampling receipts.
Validate complete processor length/cost and all14 candidate runtime parity.
academic_scope: No original 60/40 folds or AudioJev672 subset reproduced. Native paper pipeline is literature reference, not an authorized ASR-to-text execution branch.
